brandMigration.description: NexaTerm found data from the previous mXterm app identity. You can copy it into NexaTerm before the workspace starts. The original mXterm data is left untouched.
brandMigration.blockedTitle: mXterm data found, but NexaTerm already has data
brandMigration.blockedDescription: NexaTerm will not overwrite existing user data. Keep using the current data, or export/back it up before attempting a manual migration.
brandMigration.restartFailed: Migration completed, but automatic restart failed. Please restart NexaTerm manually.
brandMigration.settingsDescription: NexaTerm found settings from the previous mXterm WebView profile. Importing them restores appearance, shortcuts, startup preferences, and custom Local/WSL profiles. The old mXterm profile is left untouched.
brandMigration.settingsUnsupportedTitle: Core mXterm data migrated; some settings need review
brandMigration.settingsUnsupportedDescri: On macOS, the previous mXterm default WKWebView store cannot be addressed safely by NexaTerm through the supported Tauri data-directory API. Core app data and encrypted secrets were migrated, but appearance, shortcuts, startup preferences, and custom Local/WSL profiles may need to be configured again. The original mXterm data remains untouched.
